findings.headline: GlobalFoundries and TSMC agree on $2 billion U.S. AI interposer production
findings.summary: GlobalFoundries will manufacture silicon interposers for TSMC CoWoS AI chip packaging at its Malta, New York fab under a five-year $2 billion agreement. Volume production is expected to ramp in the first half of 2028.
findings.why_it_matters: This expands the planned domestic supply of a critical processor-to-memory packaging component; production is not yet underway.
findings.trend_statement: AI hardware capacity investment is moving beyond leading-edge logic to advanced packaging.

source_links.title: GlobalFoundries and TSMC agree on $2 billion U.S. AI interposer production

findings.headline: Wolfspeed receives conditional $1.5 billion U.S. government financing commitment
findings.summary: Wolfspeed announced a conditional 30-year loan commitment of up to $1.5 billion for domestic silicon carbide and gallium nitride semiconductor production and related technology. Funding remains subject to due diligence, final agreements and approvals.
findings.why_it_matters: The potential financing could expand domestic wide-bandgap semiconductor capacity, but it is not a funded loan.
findings.trend_statement: Strategic financing is targeting domestic production of critical power and communications chips.

source_links.title: Wolfspeed receives conditional $1.5 billion U.S. government financing commitment

findings.headline: Microsoft makes execution containers for AI agents generally available
findings.summary: Microsoft announced general availability of Microsoft Execution Containers on Windows 11. Developers can declare file and network access restrictions enforced outside an agent's control. Codex, GitHub Copilot and other agents already integrate with MXC; additional enterprise management features remain planned.
findings.why_it_matters: OS-enforced agent permissions offer a supported alternative to relying on model behavior for security.
findings.trend_statement: Agent security is shifting toward independent runtime policy enforcement.

source_links.title: Microsoft makes execution containers for AI agents generally available

findings.headline: FDA approves first indicated treatment for symptomatic dermographism
findings.summary: Novartis announced FDA approval of Rhapsido (remibrutinib) for adults with symptomatic dermographism not controlled by H1 antihistamines. In Phase III RemIND, 29.3% of treated patients versus 14.0% on placebo achieved complete hive response at week 12.
findings.why_it_matters: A new approved indication provides the first specifically approved treatment for this chronic condition.
findings.trend_statement: Targeted oral immunology treatments are expanding to underserved chronic conditions.

source_links.title: FDA approves first indicated treatment for symptomatic dermographism
